# braintrust_org_automation (Resource)

Manages an organization-wide Braintrust retention policy. Available only on plans that permit custom retention.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "org_id" {
  type = string
}

# Organization-wide retention policies require a plan with custom retention.
# Keep one policy per object type in an organization.
resource "braintrust_org_automation" "experiment_retention" {
  org_id = var.org_id
  name   = "Experiment retention"

  retention_config = {
    object_type    = "experiment"
    retention_days = 90
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the retention policy.
- `org_id` (String) Organization this policy applies to.
- `retention_config` (Attributes) Organization-wide retention period for one object type. At most one policy per object type can exist in an organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retention_config))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the policy.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of policy creation.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the organization automation.
- `user_id` (String) User who created the policy.

<a id="nestedatt--retention_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retention_config`

Required:

- `object_type` (String) The retained object type. One of: `project_logs`, `experiment`, `dataset`.
- `retention_days` (Number) Number of days to retain data. 0 means delete immediately.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the org automation ID.
terraform import braintrust_org_automation.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
